claim_text: Post merger, we focused on extending our safety standards across our newly-acquired Southern Goldfields operations, and by year end we were pleased to report a 37% decrease in our Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The claim is supported because the report states that LTIFR decreased by 37% by year end, and the safety performance table shows LTIFR falling from 0.62 in FY24 to 0.39 in FY25.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that, after the merger and extension of safety standards to the newly acquired Southern Goldfields operations, the company achieved a 37% decrease in Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate by year end. No evidence fields were provided to substantiate any part of this (no LTIFR values, baseline and year-end figures, timeframe, scope covering Southern Goldfields, or documentation of the safety-standards rollout). Because the 37% reduction and the stated post-merger operational scope are not verified by any provided evidence, the claim is not meaningfully supported.
